name: aws-bedrock
title: AWS Bedrock
description: Invoke Model of AWS Bedrock service.
label: ai,cloud

properties.name: label
properties.description: Logical name

properties.name: guardrailIdentifier
properties.description: The identifier (ID or ARN) for the guardrail to apply to the model invocation

properties.name: guardrailTrace
properties.description: Whether to return trace information from the guardrail

properties.name: guardrailVersion
properties.description: The version of the guardrail to use. Defaults to DRAFT.

properties.name: includeStreamingMetadata
properties.description: Whether to include streaming metadata in the response headers (completion reason, token count, chunk count)

properties.name: modelId
properties.description: Define the model Id we are going to use

properties.name: operation
properties.description: The operation to perform

properties.name: overrideEndpoint
properties.description: Set the need for overriding the endpoint. This option needs to be used in combination with the uriEndpointOverride option

properties.name: pojoRequest
properties.description: If we want to use a POJO request as body or not

properties.name: profileCredentialsName
properties.description: If using a profile credentials provider, this parameter will set the profile name

properties.name: region
properties.description: The region in which Bedrock client needs to work. When using this parameter, the configuration will expect the lowercase name of the region (for example, ap-east-1) You'll need to use the name Region.EU_WEST_1.id()

properties.name: streamOutputMode
properties.description: The streaming output mode (complete or chunks). In complete mode, the full response is accumulated and returned as a single message. In chunks mode, each chunk is emitted as a separate exchange.

properties.name: uriEndpointOverride
properties.description: Set the overriding uri endpoint. This option needs to be used in combination with overrideEndpoint option

properties.name: useDefaultCredentialsProvider
properties.description: Set whether the Bedrock client should expect to load credentials through a default credentials provider or to expect static credentials to be passed in.

properties.name: useProfileCredentialsProvider
properties.description: Set whether the Bedrock client should expect to load credentials through a profile credentials provider.

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: bedrockRuntimeAsyncClient
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: To use an existing configured AWS Bedrock Runtime Async client for streaming operations

properties.name: bedrockRuntimeClient
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: To use an existing configured AWS Bedrock Runtime client

properties.name: proxyHost
properties.label: proxy
properties.description: To define a proxy host when instantiating the Bedrock client

properties.name: proxyPort
properties.label: proxy
properties.description: To define a proxy port when instantiating the Bedrock client

properties.name: proxyProtocol
properties.label: proxy
properties.description: To define a proxy protocol when instantiating the Bedrock client

properties.name: accessKey
properties.label: security
properties.description: Amazon AWS Access Key

properties.name: secretKey
properties.label: security
properties.description: Amazon AWS Secret Key

properties.name: sessionToken
properties.label: security
properties.description: Amazon AWS Session Token used when the user needs to assume an IAM role

properties.name: trustAllCertificates
properties.label: security
properties.description: If we want to trust all certificates in case of overriding the endpoint

properties.name: useSessionCredentials
properties.label: security
properties.description: Set whether the Bedrock client should expect to use Session Credentials. This is useful in a situation in which the user needs to assume an IAM role for doing operations in Bedrock.
